subject: Valid day interpretation from Part 2 to Part 5

messages.author: f70fd42c76a01c4c
messages.subject: Valid day interpretation from Part 2 to Part 5
parts:
Hello,

I have a question regarding the interpretation of valid days in part 2 vs part 5. Here's my code:
PA_algorithm <- "vanHees2015"
GGIR::GGIR(datadir= "",
           outputdir= "",
           minimum_WW_length.part5 = 10,
           minimum_MM_length.part5 = 10,
           includedaycrit = 10,
           dofirstpage =FALSE,
           do.parallel = FALSE,
           strategy = 1,
           excludefirstlast.part5 = FALSE,
           do.enmo = TRUE,
           ignorenonwear= TRUE ,
           acc.metric = "ENMO",
           do.visual= TRUE,
           threshold.lig = c(44.8),
           threshold.mod = c(100.6),
           threshold.vig = c(428.8),
           data_masking_strategy = 5,
           maxdur = 4,
           Nvaliddays= 4,
           HASIB.algo = PA_algorithm
)

I have been using this code to calculate the time spent in various physical activity zones.

 I have about 48 files however  12 of them have less than 4 days of valid data according to the part 5 person summary but that's not the case according to the part 2 summary file or the file summary visualisation report. R reports the following error:

Warning message:
In breaks_i[bi] <- fullQqq[grep(breaks[bi], ts$time[fullQqq])] :
  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

 I am unsure where this error generating from. I tried to change a couple of code lines such as non-wear time and daycrit value however it wasn't the most helpful. I would really appreciate if someone can help me out.
